ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

   B. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
